literature_cards.title: Boundary loss for highly unbalanced segmentation
literature_cards.advisory_claim: Regional overlap objectives can underrepresent small structures; boundary-aware objectives are a relevant future mechanism, but are not executable in this frozen V10 surface.

literature_cards.title: Unified Focal loss: Generalising Dice and cross entropy-based losses to handle class imbalanced medical image segmentation
literature_cards.advisory_claim: Loss design can address class imbalance; V10 tests only registered MONAI loss implementations rather than reproducing unverified paper-specific settings.

literature_cards.title: A novel Focal Tversky loss function with improved Attention U-Net for lesion segmentation
literature_cards.advisory_claim: Tversky-style weighting motivates an asymmetry-sensitive registered comparator for weaker tissues.

literature_cards.title: Topology-Preserving Deep Image Segmentation
literature_cards.advisory_claim: Fetal cortical topology is scientifically relevant, but topology loss remains outside V10 until a bounded multiclass implementation and cost calibration exist.
